patch_description: The current batch selector takes three surrogate-favored moves, then fills from the next few ranked moves; its shuffled tail is effectively unreachable when the batch limit is five. This can repeatedly spend LP calls on near-neighbors favored by a surrogate that is only loosely correlated with the exact routing score. Keep two strong-energy proposals, but deliberately sample the remaining slots across the rest of the energy-ranked neighborhood. This provides a low-cost form of online robustness to surrogate misranking while retaining exploitation and the existing LP budget.
